# Grid

Used for navigation of multiple sub-functions in the page.

## Grid

### Props

| Name | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns | Number of columns. | `number` | - |

### CSS Variables

| Name | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| --gap | Gap size. | `0` |
| --gap-horizontal | Horizontal gap size. | `var(--gap)` |
| --gap-vertical | Vertical gap size. | `var(--gap)` |

## Grid.Item

### Props

| Name | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| span | Number of columns spanned. | `number` | `1` |
